issues_detected.title: Water Stain on Ceiling
issues_detected.description: A large brown water stain is visible around the light fixture on the ceiling, indicating a possible leak from above.
issues_detected.recommendation: Investigate the source of the leak, which may be from plumbing or roof issues. Repair the leak and replace any damaged materials to prevent mold growth.

analysis.overall_assessment: The ceiling shows signs of water damage, likely from a leak, which needs immediate attention to prevent further damage.
